title: Action of the code projection
statement: Let $C$ be a closed subspace of the $n$-qubit Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_n$, and let $P_C : \mathcal{H}_n \to \mathcal{H}_n$ be the associated orthogonal projection onto $C$. Then for every $x \in \mathcal{H}_n$, the value $P_C\,x$ is exactly the orthogonal projection of $x$ onto $C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a subspace of the n-qubit Hilbert space
x is an element of the n-qubit Hilbert space
replaced:
For any $x \in \mathcal{H}_n$, the value $P_C\,x$ coincides with the orthogonal projection
$\Pi_C(x)$ of $x$ onto $C$.
